events.title: Cook: Chicken Biryani (dinner, 1 of 2)
events.description:
Dinner for 2 people (your household setting).
The recipe makes 4 servings; for 2, use 1/2 of each amount.

Ingredients, as the recipe gives them:
- 800 g Chicken Thighs
- 400 g Basmati Rice
- 200 g Plain Yogurt, for the marinade
- 300 g Yellow Onion, 2 medium, sliced
- 15 g Garlic, about 4 cloves
- 20 g Ginger, a thumb-sized piece
- 10 g Green Chilies, 2, slit
- 10 g Garam Masala
- 3 g Turmeric
- 5 g Chili Powder
- 40 g Ghee
- 10 g Fresh Mint, a handful of leaves
- 15 g Cilantro, a handful
- 3 g Green Cardamom Pods, about 6 pods
- 8 g Salt

Nutrition per serving (demo amounts): ≥ 770 kcal, ≥ 51 g protein, ≥ 20 g fat, ≥ 9.3 g saturated fat, ≥ 93 g carbohydrate, ≥ 3.6 g fibre, ≥ 5.4 g sugars, ≥ 1,034 mg sodium.
14 of 15 ingredients counted, 99% by weight.

events.title: Thaw: move Chicken Thighs Bone-In to the fridge
events.description:

Source: U.S. Department of Agriculture, The Big Thaw — Safe Defrosting Methods, rule fsis-thaw-fridge-small: "Even small amounts of frozen food — such as a pound of ground meat or boneless chicken breasts — require a full day to thaw."
